title: Penguin wearing sunglasses
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>

  <ellipse cx='50' cy='66' rx='26' ry='29' fill='#3a4a7a'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='70' rx='17' ry='23' fill='#e8f0ff'/>

  <circle cx='50' cy='32' r='19' fill='#3a4a7a'/>

  <ellipse cx='50' cy='36' rx='14' ry='12' fill='#e8f0ff'/>

  <ellipse cx='41' cy='31' rx='9' ry='7' fill='#1a1a2e'/>
  <ellipse cx='59' cy='31' rx='9' ry='7' fill='#1a1a2e'/>

  <ellipse cx='56' cy='28' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#6fd6ff'/>

  <rect x='47' y='29' width='6' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#1a1a2e'/>

  <rect x='32' y='28' width='3' height='6' rx='1.5' fill='#1a1a2e'/>
  <rect x='65' y='28' width='3' height='6' rx='1.5' fill='#1a1a2e'/>
  <!-- beak -->
  <path d='M46 40 L54 40 L50 47 Z' fill='#ffb020'/>

  <ellipse cx='40' cy='93' rx='9' ry='4' fill='#ffb020'/>

  <!-- left flipper -->
  <ellipse cx='24' cy='64' rx='7' ry='17' fill='#2c3a66' transform='rotate(12 24 64)'/>
  <!-- right flipper -->
  <ellipse cx='76' cy='64' rx='7' ry='17' fill='#2c3a66' transform='rotate(-12 76 64)'/>
</svg>
